groupfit.architecture_note: Shared C fixed to leading two uniform training PCA directions; private rank3 groups fit residuals. This is staged shared/private learning, not jointly optimized arbitrary memberships. One active group used for causal evaluation; both-gate union correctness audited algebraically. Private groups may overlap geometrically.

config.fit: Uncentered SVD of training raw L6 pre-MLP responses. Normalize each training response to unit norm, then normalize each task matrix Frobenius norm before shared fit; task-specific fit uses its own normalized rows. Orthogonal projections; no intercept.
config.selection: Every third sorted lexical item held out, all variants grouped. Previously examined panels; internal fit holdout, not fresh evidence.
config.comparisons: Shared rank r vs specific rank r matches active dimension but specific total storage is2r; shared rank2r vs specific rankr matches total storage. No trained sparse gates, taxonomy, or computational DAG.
config.group_fit: Compare independent two-rank4, independent two-rank5, and shared PCA2 plus two residual rank3 groups. Five restarts seeds8140-8144 per model, uniform unit-response weights, fit/gate no task labels, training error selection only; same heldout split. Shared block fixed before residual-group fit. Union shared atom contribution counted once.
config.distribution_metric: KL(full uncompressed intervention output || candidate output), computed in float64 across full vocabulary; full is same source perturbation and input-response arm, not zero/native baseline. Reverse KL and total variation secondary. No heldout gate selection.
config.ablation_design: Frozen H815 bases and gates; select group from original dx once, then keep both/shared-only/private-only/neither, or substitute the other private block while keeping shared. No gate recomputation after deletion. Compare fidelity with exact uncompressed module response.
config.primary: Heldout causal response fidelity and context-gap preservation, plus input reconstruction. Full source perturbation/recipient baseline retained.
